name: timewarrior
description: timewarrior — time tracking CLI. Track activities, generate reports, and manage timesheets from the command line.

install_steps: curl -LO https://github.com/GothenburgBitFactory/timewarrior/releases/download/v1.9.1/timew-1.9.1-linux-x86_64.tar.gz && tar xzf timew-1.9.1-linux-x86_64.tar.gz && sudo mv timew /usr/local/bin/ && rm -rf timew-1.9.1-linux-x86_64.tar.gz
install_guidance.note: Binary from GitHub releases or package manager.
